name: Sawai Maya
source:
Likes: Studying, family
Dislikes: Insincere people, robots

Maya is the class president of [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki's[/url] class. She performs her duties faithfully and diligently. And despite the fact that Maya seems grumpy and has no friends, in her heart she's still a girl who dreams about a normal girl's happiness. However, her life can not be called simple. A family tragedy left a mark in her heart...
